name: The Infinite Hive
tagline: An idle game: from one backyard hive to a galaxy of honey
goal: Grow a brand-new hive as far as you can in 15 minutes.
scoring: 1,000 × log10 of all the honey you make (1 million honey = 6,000), +250 per research, +400 per kind of Phase I building you own, +20,000 for reaching Phase II (+20 per second still on the clock) and up to 30,000 more for blooming Earth; Phase III adds 40,000 (+20 per second left) and up to 60,000 more.

modifiers.name: Time Warp
modifiers.text: The whole hive runs 3× fast: seasons, production, Royal Bees, events and buffs.

modifiers.name: Hundred-Fold Hands
modifiers.text: Every click on the comb is worth ×100.

modifiers.name: Hands Off
modifiers.text: The comb can’t be clicked at all. You start with 3 Worker Bees and 30 coins, and the hive makes ×3 honey on its own.

modifiers.name: Clearance Sale
modifiers.text: Everything costs half: bees, buildings, scouts, comb frames, research, Royal Cells and Edicts.

modifiers.name: Big Swarm
modifiers.text: Start with a grown colony: 50 Worker Bees, 20 Forager Troops, 8 Hive Boxes, 6 Scouts, Auto-Sell and 2,000 coins.

modifiers.name: Honey Storms
modifiers.text: Wild honey storms sweep the yard every 30–60 seconds: 12 seconds of honey ×10, clicks ×10 and storage ×10.

modifiers.name: Keep Buzzing
modifiers.text: Bees only work while your mouse is moving (keep a finger dragging on a phone), but then they work ×3.

modifiers.name: Runaway Inflation
modifiers.text: Clicks are worth ×10, but every click on the comb makes every price 0.3% higher, for good.

modifiers.name: Her Royal Hugeness
modifiers.text: The Queen is enormous: a giant comb, a Royal Bee every 10–20 seconds, and every Royal Bee brings two rewards.

modifiers.name: Wild Market
modifiers.text: The honey price swings between a tenth and five times its fair value. Sell on the spikes.

modifiers.name: Weather Whiplash
modifiers.text: Seasons last 10 seconds and go to extremes: summer makes ×4, winter almost nothing, but winter honey sells for ×4.

modifiers.name: Compound Interest
modifiers.text: Coins in your purse earn 0.5% interest every second.

modifiers.name: Bee Mitosis
modifiers.text: Every minute the colony splits: +50% of every bee and building you own (up to +100 of each).

modifiers.name: Bear Country
modifiers.text: A hungry bear charges the hive every 45–90 seconds. Click it 8 times to drive it off, or it eats half your honey and a quarter of your coins.
